nave.name: Landing ship
nave.desc: Your starting home. It holds base storage.
nave.why: You already have it. It does not spend power.

generador.name: Oxygen generator
generador.desc: Splits water into oxygen with power.
generador.why: Makes air to breathe. Needs water and power.

reciclador.name: Water recycler
reciclador.desc: Returns part of the water the crew used.
reciclador.why: Recovers used water so less is lost.

extractor.name: Ice extractor
extractor.why: New water from ice. Place only on ice.

refugio.name: Radiation shelter
refugio.desc: Shields the crew during solar storms.

tormenta-solar.name: Solar storm
tormenta-solar.desc: Fast particles from the Sun reach your base.
tormenta-solar.today: Solar storm today: choose shelter or work

power.title: Energy and batteries
power.body: Solar panels turn sunlight into electricity. In the shade they make less. Batteries store what is left over for later.

waterLoop.title: Water that returns
waterLoop.body: In space, water is recycled. On the Space Station nearly 90% comes back. Your base recovers 75%: that number is a game value.

airFromWater.title: Air from water
airFromWater.body: Water holds oxygen. With electricity you can split it. That process is electrolysis. The Space Station makes oxygen this way.

growFood.title: Food that grows
growFood.body: Plants need water, light, and time. If one day they miss something, the harvest comes later and is smaller.

firstAir.title: Air first
firstAir.body: Without air you last a short time. Without water a bit longer. Without food longer still. The game checks needs in that order.

solarStorm.title: Solar storm
solarStorm.body: Sometimes the Sun throws fast particles. NASA records those events. The one you see here was real. Base radiation numbers are game values.

moonIce.title: Lunar ice
moonIce.body: In this mission, ice sits in a crater floor. Your extractor turns it into water for the base. This map detail is story for the game.

signalDelay.title: Signals that take time
signalDelay.body: Radio signals travel at light speed. They still take time: about a second to the Moon, and minutes to Mars.

tutorial.t01: This is your base. Above you see energy, life support, and protection.
tutorial.t02: Without power nothing works. Build a solar panel.
tutorial.t03: There is mineral near the ship. Collect it for more materials.
tutorial.t04: Sensors detect ice to the southeast. Explore that way.
tutorial.t05: Press End day to see what happened.
tutorial.t06: Place an extractor on ice and a recycler. That gives you water.
tutorial.t07: The generator makes oxygen from water. The greenhouse grows food every 4 days.
tutorial.t08: Low light is coming. A battery stores energy for that day.
tutorial.t09: Solar storm ahead. The shelter takes 2 days: build it today.
tutorial.t10: You decide. Each option has a cost.
tutorial.t11: Stable day. Keep the streak to finish the mission.

decision.noShelter: You do not have a shelter yet

decision.compareWork: Without shelter: +{with} exposure. With shelter it would be +{without}.
decision.leadLabel: Minutes from flare to first particles

learning.question: What should a crew do when a solar storm arrives?
learning.optionA: Keep working outside to save time
learning.optionB: Take shelter even if it costs energy and a work day
learning.optionC: Turn off all solar panels forever
